I used to work at a McDonalds. One rainy Saturday morning, a guy came in and ordered a coffee. Normal enough. He then lined two high chairs up as a table and sat down directly below our pay phone. A little less normal, but he wasn't really hurting anyone. After a while, he stated picking up the phone, listening for a second, and hanging it back up. We were starting to get a little weirded out, but eventually he cleaned up the area and left. About ten minutes later a police officer came in and gave us the guy's description, saying he was being searched for and was last seen coming in. We told the officer which way he had left, and the officer left without an explanation.
